title: PixelKin - A Milagro Card (the reveal)
_note: One-shot, ~4.5 s: the moment a Booji-Wooji Man milagro card turns over in your hands. A little music box: a lilting 3/4 figure that climbs like a held breath (E-G-B... up to the high E), a tender suspension on the A-minor turn, and a warm landing on C major with a bell shimmer. Cherished, not triumphant: quieter and rounder than the Gleam/kindle fanfares, the feel of being handed something precious.
